title: How To Disable Brilliant Directories' Default CSS
text:
## How To Disable Brilliant Directories' Default CSS
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076876
Brilliant Directories' default CSS stylesheet can be deactivated using the Advanced Setting:
Disable Default CSS Stylesheet
System Variable: website_disable_css_stylesheets
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647437/original/OCY1CwVrs0aQaFqgA6gtqUy7SCHRALQh5w.png?1753161403 | alt: ]
Once the Advanced Setting has been turned on and since there will be no link to a stylesheet, the website will look broken like this:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280685/original/ebVmUp4lrgww3Ra7-1hXYmtiGKtAsQlpXg.png?1645319198 | alt: ]
If the custom CSS stylesheets are hosted elsewhere, the way to link this will be using the Custom CSS / HEAD section,
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280691/original/ZVdb3UXYFrz1yRvA9kamLnFlnIwPs8N0-g.png?1645319332 | alt: ]
Additionally, custom CSS can also be added directly to each static page. To do this, navigate to the webpage that needs to be edited and use the Advanced tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280697/original/tI3f0j6n_V8pe8je4NgGEiwQRmxMp60i-A.png?1645319400 | alt: ]
